accounts.note: The maker of the plotter, and the hero of the segment. Four of the maker's posts are shown and read aloud; the maker is never voiced, because the account spoke in the previous episode. Also credited on screen, with the stream address, for the whole segment.
Speaks one line, its own reply, to the maker's reply it answered. A cluster member, new to the show.

A small account outside the cluster's membership: one reply, as the hero of one moment, with the maker's welcome beside it. Appears nowhere else. The name is on the card and on the page but is not spoken: no house voice could say it (see notes.json).
A cluster member, new to the show. The reply is read aloud in part and written by the pen in part.

posts.author: samantha.wiki
posts.text:
🚨 Fun experiment is live! 🚨

Reply to this post and my pen plotter will write it on paper, watch it live! Only your first post in the thread gets plotted, rude replies are skipped. Once the page fills up, replies will be locked. stream.place/samantha.wiki

Who will be first? 👀
posts.note: The invitation. Read aloud by Sibyl, cut at both ends with an ellipsis: "… Reply to this post and my pen plotter will write it on paper …". Its card shows that cut and nothing more of it.

posts.author: ver.ooo
posts.text:
All right, stop, collaborate and listen
Ice is back with my brand new invention
Something grabs ahold of me tightly
Flow like a harpoon daily and nightly
"Will it ever stop?" Yo, I don't know
Turn off the lights, and I'll glow
posts.note: ver.ooo's own reply to the invitation (song lyrics). Not shown and not read: it is here because the maker's "you're up" replied to it.

posts.author: aparker.io
posts.text:
According to all known laws of aviation, there is no way a bee should be able to fly.
Its wings are too small to get its fat little body off the ground.
The bee, of course, flies anyway because bees don't care what humans think is impossible.
Yellow, black. Yellow, black. Yellow, black. Yellow, blac
posts.note: Its first sentence is read aloud by Larry from a card that shows that sentence and the cut ("According to all known laws of aviation, there is no way a bee should be able to fly. …"). Its last eight words are what the pen writes in the wordless stretch ("… Yellow, black. Yellow, black. Yellow, black. Yellow, blac"), a glance. Nothing else of it is on screen.

lines.occasion: The maker told ver.ooo its reply was next ("you're up"), and ver.ooo answered while watching the pen on the stream. Staged the same way: Larry reads the maker's reply aloud from its card, word for word; the pen runs out a line and starts back; the puppet says the reply as the pen travels. Nothing is spoken between the prompt and the line.
